about: Every seat in the bowl kit. Local yards: midfield origin, +x east, +y up, +z home sideline, -z far side (press box). A seat is [x, z, yaw]: its feet on the row's floorY, yaw in radians about +y with 0 facing +z, so the facing vector is (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw) and always points into the bowl. Section ids: 1xx lower, 3xx upper, numbered from home midfield.
